clauses.title: Radiated emissions, 30-88 MHz
clauses.requirement: Class B radiated emissions must not exceed 40 dBuV/m measured at 3 m.

clauses.title: RF exposure
clauses.requirement: Device must demonstrate SAR or MPE compliance under FCC RF exposure rules.

clauses.title: Electrical safety listing
clauses.requirement: Equipment must be listed by an NRTL against UL 62368-1.

clauses.title: Equipment authorisation
clauses.requirement: Product must display a valid FCC ID from an equipment authorisation.
